description: Korean youth monthly rent support (청년월세 지원, MOLIT, ongoing from 2026, selected within budget): ages 19-34 living apart from parents without a home; youth household income at most 60% of the 2026 median and assets at most 122M KRW; parents' household income at most 100% of median and assets at most 470M (not checked from age 30, if married or an unmarried parent); deposit at most 50M and rent at most 600k (above that, rent + deposit × 2.5% ÷ 12 at most 700k). Pays actual rent up to 200k a month for 24 months, once, minus housing benefit; excludes public rentals, landlords within 2nd-degree kin and recipients of local rent programs. Returns each check, monthly and total.

excluded.description: Public rental, landlord within 2nd-degree kin, or receiving a local rent program

parentExempt.description: Parents' household check exempt (married, unmarried parent, etc.)
